description: Re-sends a captured webhook to a URL from this machine (e.g. the local handler at http://localhost:3000/webhooks), with its original method, headers and body, so signature checks run for real. Records the result in the dashboard's replay history and returns the verdict against the previous attempt to the same URL: fixed, regressed, still_failing or still_passing. For an event whose signature is invalid, the handler passes by rejecting it (4xx). It can change state in the receiving app (it is a real webhook delivery).

event_id.description: Which event: its number (12 or "#12", from list_events or the dashboard), "latest", "latest <event type>" such as "latest invoice.paid", or the provider's own event id such as evt_1Qx...

target_url.description: Where to deliver it, e.g. http://localhost:3000/webhooks

name: replay_event
title: Replay event
